sources.snippet: Floppa-12B-Gemma3 (Uncensored) Floppa-12B is a fine-tuned multimodal model based on Google's Gemma 3 12B Instruct. It has been specialized for high-fidelity uncensored translation (Japanese <-> English) and unrestricted image description.
